rounded.heading: Rounded corners
rounded.text: An image with border radius for rounded corners

missing.heading: Missing plain image
missing.text: Image not found but rendered as a placeholder.

cover.heading: Cover image
cover.text: Image with cover mode, that covers the parent container.

container-query.heading: Container query switching (default)
container-query.text: The default behaviour for an ImageInterface source with several candidate sizes: one per size, switched by CSS container queries. Inspect the element to see multiple tags, only one of which is visible at a time.

responsive.heading: Single image via srcset (opt-in)
responsive.text: Setting preferSrcset renders a single using srcset, sizes and container query data instead of one per breakpoint. Inspect the element to verify only one is rendered.

focus-point.heading: Focus point
focus-point.text: A responsive image with an off-center focus point, verifying that object-position is applied together with the srcset/sizes attributes.

lqip.heading: Low quality image placeholder
lqip.text: A responsive image with a low quality placeholder shown as a background while the full image loads.

single-candidate.heading: Single candidate size
single-candidate.text: An image contract with only one candidate size. No srcset or sizes attribute should be rendered.

eager-priority.heading: Eager loading with priority
eager-priority.text: Overriding imgAttributeList to opt out of the lazy-loading default, useful for above-the-fold images such as a Hero background.
